name: comp-384

frames.best_why: Popover is fully open above the trigger with title, paragraph and the Know more button.

tagline: A small callout above a button holds a short note and a Know more action.
summary: An outlined button opens a compact card above it with a bold heading, a short explanatory paragraph and a white action button. It is a popover styled to resemble a tooltip.
appearance: A rounded dark popover floats above an outlined 'Tooltip-like popover' button on a near-black page. Inside is a bold heading, two lines of grey copy, and a small white 'Know more' button at the lower left; the panel has soft rounded corners and no arrow.
behaviour: Clicking the trigger opens the popover above it; clicking elsewhere or pressing Escape closes it. The Know more button is clickable but carries no action in the demo.
demo_content: Trigger 'Tooltip-like popover'; card says 'Popover with button' plus a line about needing an interactive element.
search_phrases: popup with text and a button
small info card with action link
click to open a helper panel
tooltip style popup you can click
floating card with know more button
use_when: A short explanation needs an inline action, which a plain tooltip cannot host.
avoid_when: The popover has no arrow and can overlap content; it also needs a click rather than hover.
customise: The heading, paragraph and button label are fixed in the file; adapting the copy or adding a real action means editing the source.
weight_why: A small static panel and one button; no animation loop.

a11y.note: Keyboard opens and closes the popover and the inner button is reachable, but the panel is not labelled by its heading.

issues: The Know more button has no handler, so the action does nothing.
The trigger label 'Tooltip-like popover' describes the demo, not a task.
polish_why: Clean minimal popover; the demo label and inert action keep it ordinary.
